title: OutcomeReport
description: Independent outcome verification for one run's effects (spec 9.5). Verdicts come from external state, service receipts, deterministic fixtures, or independently tested graders — never from the worker's final text. Unknown outcomes remain unknown.

healthy.description: False when the verifier's own self-check failed (known-good fixture did not pass, or known-bad fixture was not caught). An unhealthy verifier answers unknown for everything (spec 9.5: verifier health is itself tested).

expectation.description: effect: the consequential change must have landed. no_effect: it must not have (for example, an unauthorized read must not have occurred).

verdict.description: failed means authoritative evidence contradicts the expectation. unknown means no authoritative evidence either way: absent checks, errored checks, or grader-only support (a grader must not be the sole ground-truth oracle, spec 9.5).

strongest_kind.description: The strongest assertion kind that produced this verdict; none when nothing ran.

grader_only.description: True when the only support came from a semantic grader. Such an outcome is reported unknown, not passed.

event_id.description: Evidence event backing this assertion, when one exists.

source_ref.description: The state source, fixture, or grader consulted.

evidence.description: Every check that ran, with its result. An empty list is a verdict of unknown with strongest_kind none.

allOf.description: An unhealthy verifier must say why (spec 9.5).
